test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Nagamani, a brave student, lodged a F.I.R. against the criminal.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term "**a F.I.R.**" is incorrect as the abbreviation F.I.R. (First Information Report) begins with a vowel sound.
 
• The correct article to use before "F.I.R." is "**an**", not "**a**".
 
• Thus, the correct phrase should be "**an F.I.R.**" to maintain grammatical correctness.
 
• This error is present in **Option 1**, making it the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Nagamani, a brave student, lodged an F.I.R. against the criminal."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "student, lodged"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "against the criminal"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "Nagamani, a brave,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
